title: Adv. Eng. II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**




+ Design, develop, and customize Alfresco Content Services solutions, including workflows, custom content models, and integrations with external systems.
+ Deploy and manage Alfresco instances on AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM), leveraging cloud services for scalability, security, and high availability.
+ Integrate Alfresco with other applications using microservices architecture (Spring Boot), REST APIs, and Node.js services.
+ Build and maintain modern front-end components for Alfresco applications using Angular and JavaScript.
+ Integrate, configure, and optimize Apache Solr for advanced search capabilities within Alfresco solutions, ensuring fast and accurate content retrieval.
+ Apply SQL expertise for efficient data storage, retrieval, and performance tuning within Alfresco deployments.
+ Monitor and tune Alfresco performance, including database connection pools, Solr indexing, and AWS resource utilization.
+ Debug and resolve technical issues related to Alfresco, SQL, AWS, JavaScript frameworks, and Solr components.
+ Work closely with cross-functional teams, including architects, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders, to deliver solutions aligned with organizational goals.
+ Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including solution designs, configuration guides, and user manuals, to support ongoing development and knowledge sharing.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**




+ 5+ years of hands-on experience with Alfresco Content Services (Enterprise Edition).
+ 2+ years of experience working with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM).
+ Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Framework, and RESTful APIs.
+ Experience in designing and implementing Alfresco content models, behaviours, web scripts, workflows, and REST APIs.
+ Experience developing integrations with external systems and building modern front-end components using Angular/ADF (Alfresco Development Framework).
+ Familiarity with ACS and APS SDKs.

* Preferred/Good to Have:

+ Experience with ACS 6.x or later versions and understanding of the latest architecture.
+ Exposure to CI/CD processes using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub.
+ Hands-on experience with Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.
+ Certification in Alfresco Content Services or AWS (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Developer).
+ Experience with Alfresco integrations using AWS S3 for content storage or AWS Aurora for database management.
+ Familiarity with microservices architecture and serverless computing on AWS.
+ Knowledge of other ECM platforms or programming languages (Python, Kotlin).

* Soft Skills:

+ Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
+ Excellent communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
+ Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee
  
  
**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
Yes
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
  
  
Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:
  

* Competitive Compensation
* Flexible, Hybrid Work
* 30 days’ Annual Leave + Public Holidays
* Life Insurance
* Retirement Planning
* Group Personal Accident Insurance
* Medical Insurance for Employee and Family
* Annual Health Check-up
* 26 weeks Maternity Leave
* Paternal Leave
* Adoption Leave
* Near site Childcare Facility
* Employee Assistance Program
* Study Support
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* ESG Commitments and Goals
* Business Resource Groups
* Career Development Programs
* Mentoring Programs
* Invesco Cares
* Dress for your Day

In Invesco, we offer development opportunities that help you thrive as a lifelong learner in a constantly evolving business environment and ensure your constant growth. Our AI enabled learning platform delivers curated content based on your role and interest. We ensure our manager and leaders also have many opportunities to advance their skills and competencies that becomes pivotal in their continuous pursuit of performance excellence.
  
  
**To Know More About Us**

About our Culture: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/about-us/our-culture.html

title: Manager, Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Manager for Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support to join our team. As a Manager for Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support, you will drive critical data operations that enable clinical research at scale. This position plays a key role in leading technical support teams, ensuring data pipeline reliability, maintaining regulatory compliance, and delivering exceptional service to internal and external stakeholders. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, establish best practices, and contribute to data platform excellence from strategy through execution. Responsibilities include overseeing L2 support operations, leading and developing high-performing teams, and driving continuous improvement across Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Denodo, and Power BI environments.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through supporting data-driven clinical research, building technical excellence, and advancing data platform capabilities. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Manager for Data Aggregation & Distribution L2 Support can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology and data operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, manage, and develop a team of 14 L2 data support specialists, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance oversight to foster a high-performance culture.
* Oversee the triage, diagnosis, and resolution of data pipeline, ingestion, and distribution issues, acting as an escalation point for complex technical problems.
* Monitor support queue performance and service levels, ensuring timely issue resolution and maintaining agreed SLAs across all data platforms.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders including platform data teams, data engineering, analytics, and business functions to identify requirements and resolve recurring issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve data support operations, pipeline reliability, and team efficiency through continuous process improvement and innovation.
* Maintain and enforce support procedures, runbooks, and escalation protocols while ensuring team adherence to IT procedures, quality standards, and data governance requirements.

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strong people management and team leadership capability with a proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams.
* Experience with cloud data platforms including Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and Denodo, with hands-on knowledge of data pipeline monitoring and troubleshooting.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* A data-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, analytical problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure.
* Comfort working with ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow), ticketing systems, and modern cloud-based solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience).
* 2-5 years of demonstrated experience managing technical support or data operations teams, preferably in an enterprise or CRO environment.
* Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, and Denodo.
* Proven experience supporting or operating within Medallion Architecture-based Data Lake environments.
* Track record of leading and developing teams of 10 or more technical staff.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant cloud platform certifications (e.g., Microsoft Azure Data Engineer, Databricks Certified Associate).
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent service management qualification.
* Experience managing L2 support functions including escalation management and SLA ownership.
* Familiarity with GxP or regulated life sciences data environments.
* Experience with data governance and quality standards in enterprise environments.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Sr. Engineer - Data Engineering
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Snowflake and dbt to design, build, and optimize scalable cloud data solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in developing ELT pipelines, dimensional/data modeling, SQL optimization, and implementing reliable data transformation frameworks using dbt. The role requires close collaboration with data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver high-quality, governed, and performant data products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models using Snowflake and dbt.
* Build reusable and maintainable dbt models, macros, tests, snapshots, and incremental models.
* Develop complex SQL transformations and optimize Snowflake queries for performance and cost.
* Design data models following dimensional modeling and modern data warehouse best practices.
* Implement automated data-quality checks, testing, documentation, and lineage using dbt.
* Work with Snowflake features including warehouses, databases/schemas, stages, streams/tasks, roles, and access controls.
* Troubleshoot data pipeline failures, performance issues, and data-quality problems.
* Participate in code reviews and establish engineering standards for SQL and dbt development.
* Collaborate with upstream/downstream teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets.
* Support CI/CD and automated deployment processes for dbt projects across environments.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake.
* Strong hands-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tool).
* Advanced SQL and strong understanding of query optimization.
* Experience designing and implementing ELT/data transformation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and SCD concepts.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD development practices.
* Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
* Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Experience with dbt Cloud, including jobs, environments, deployments, and CI.
* Familiarity with Snowflake security, RBAC, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

**Ideal Experience:**
5+ years in Data Engineering, including significant hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Senior Analyst Revenue Mgmt CFS TT
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Techno Functional Analyst with strong hands on experience in Model N Revenue Manager and Oracle Database to support and enhance critical Revenue Management processes, including Chargebacks, Rebates, Managed Care, Government Pricing, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.
  
  
This role requires deep technical and functional expertise, advanced SQL/PLSQL skills, and a proven ability to analyze and resolve complex data, batch processing, and integration issues within a regulated enterprise environment. The role also includes ownership of AMS coordination and close collaboration with business and delivery teams.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
  
  

* Partner with business users and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and non‑functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into solution designs, functional specifications, and implementation plans.
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, regulatory requirements, and platform best practices.
* Coordinate closely with onsite leads, offshore AMS teams, and external vendors to ensure timely incident resolution and service continuity.
* Provide functional and delivery oversight of the AMS L2/L3 support teams for the Model N application landscape.
* Analyze and resolve batch job failures, performance bottlenecks, and Oracle Scheduler–based processing issues.
* Perform advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL analysis for:
* Data validation and reconciliation
* Defect investigation and resolution
* Ad‑hoc and audit support analysis
* Troubleshoot and support system integrations and interfaces, including:
* PL/SQL‑based inbound and outbound feeds
* High‑volume transactional / EDI‑style data loads and extracts
* Support data fixes, backend loads, and controlled updates across lower and production environments, following established change and governance processes.
* Assist with SIT, UAT, and regression testing, including test scenario creation, execution, and defect triage.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies in reports, extracts, and downstream feeds in collaboration with business, integration, and reporting teams.
* Support platform upgrades and regulatory releases by assessing impact, validating customizations, and ensuring data integrity.
* Collaborate with functional, business, and vendor teams to produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation and define preventive actions.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* 10+ years of experience as a Technical / Techno‑Functional Analyst or Application Support Analyst in enterprise systems.
* Strong hands‑on experience with Model N Revenue Manager, including:

+ Chargebacks
+ Rebates
+ Managed Care
+ Government Pricing
+ Validata
+ MDM

* Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including complex joins, performance tuning, and large‑volume data analysis.
* Experience supporting Oracle Scheduler jobs, batch frameworks, and high‑volume data processing.
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical Revenue Management and gross‑to‑net processes.
* Hands‑on experience with system integrations and data interfaces.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a production‑support, ticket‑driven environment.

**Qualifications**

* Experience with Model N SaaS / AWS‑based deployments.
* Exposure to EDI transactions and pharmaceutical gross‑to‑net data flows.
* Familiarity with IT governance, change management, and validation methodologies (SIT/UAT).
* Experience working with cross‑functional stakeholders and external vendors.

**Why Sandoz?**
Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
**Join us!**
